description: This file is a shell script used for testing git's @{upstream} syntax, branch tracking, rev-parse, and related commands within a git repository. It sets up various test cases to verify correct behavior of upstream tracking references, symbolics, and error handling in the context of git.

methods.name: commit_subject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject line of a commit in the clone directory.

methods.name: error_message
methods.description: Executes a git rev-parse command expecting it to fail and captures the error message.
